noah: FYI onboarding atlas-48k-q5: intermittent KV page shift after very long prefill + resumable streaming. Repro attached.
talia: Can you drop the minimal log where it goes wrong?
noah: tail (prefill=36000 seed=99):
```
[2026-03-23T02:14:20Z] PREFILL: wrote 36000 tokens to kv(shard2)
[2026-03-23T02:14:24Z] KV_VERIFY: page_offset 0x0fa0 expected 0x9b got 0x1b
[2026-03-23T02:14:24Z] GENERATE: mismatch at token_idx=36205
[2026-03-23T02:14:24Z] MODEL: max_pos=49152 prefill=36000 inflight=205
```
kevin: Hmm. 48k model, q5 path — could be rotary angle wrapping when pos>32768 then stitching miscalculates page base. Have you tried forcing pos-mode=wrap to see if it's a write vs compute problem?
noah: Trying `--pos-mode=wrap` and `--force-kernel=f16_rope` now. Reproducer cmd: `tools/repro_longprefill --model atlas-48k-q5 --prefill 36000 --seed 99 --stream=true --log=debug`
mei: ops-bot summary: run z7c4: model=atlas-48k-q5 prefill=36000 throughput=8.7 toks/s kv_mismatch=1.6% reproducible=3/3 link: https://ops/rep/z7c4
talia: If forcing f16_rope fixes it, that points at quantized angle encoding. Also collect a hex-dump around the failing page (addr-128..addr+128) and a phase dump for positions 32000..37000.
noah: Quick update: forcing f16_rope removed the mismatch on 2/2 runs. Will attach phase diffs and hex dumps to a GH issue.
kevin: OK next actions: 1) file kernel bug with repro + phase diff; 2) short-term: add onboarding gate to use f16_rope for prefill>30k on q5/q6; 3) add unit test to assert monotonicity of quantized phase encode for pos up to model.max_pos.
noah: Will file issue "quant-angle-wrap: page-base misalign + KV stitch on long-prefill (atlas-48k-q5)" and upload artifacts. Thanks. :thumbsup:
